about: Tuned serving recipes for open models: engine, kernels, speculative decoding, batching and memory, with a quality gate. Every command runs from the repo root. Every server is OpenAI-compatible.
notes: Recipes download 70-125 GB of weights and hold a whole GPU. Ask the user before setup steps.
Throughput is output tok/s per GPU at 8K in / 1K out with unique prompts unless the result says otherwise.
Quality is reasoning-on math / code / tools (GSM8K 50, HumanEval 30, 11 tool calls).

recipes.result: 7,264 burst / 7,053 sustained output tok/s at 160 users (5.8x the stock B200 recipe; no stock B300 run)
recipes.weight_change: Mamba-2 projections re-quantized to NVFP4 (opt-in); use super-vl-b300-v2 for none
setup: cd nemotron-super-vl && docker build --build-arg NHD_STACK=v3 -t nemotron-hyperdrive:1.4.0rc1-v3 .
recipes.serve: cd nemotron-super-vl && IMAGE=nemotron-hyperdrive:1.4.0rc1-v3 MODEL=super-vl-nvfp4-m4 scripts/serve.sh configs/b300/hyperdrive-b300-v3.yaml configs/b300/hyperdrive-b300-v3.env && scripts/wait_ready.sh
